questions.text: Differentiate f(x) = (2x⁴ – 3x + 1)⁵. You do not need to simplify.
A cooling liquid has temperature T = 60/√t + 5√t + 25, 0 < t ≤ 16, where T is °C and t is minutes after being poured. Find dT/dt at t = 4.
Find the gradient of the normal to y = cos²x sin x at x = π/6.
questions.markingGuide: dy/dx = –2sin x cos x · sin x + cos²x · cos x = –2sin²x cos x + cos³x. At x=π/6: –2(1/4)(√3/2)+(√3/2)³ = –√3/4+3√3/8 = (–2√3+3√3)/8 = √3/8. Gradient of normal = –8/√3 = –8√3/3.

questions.text: f(x) = x² + e^(2x). Find point P, the x-intercept of the tangent at x = 0.
Parametric equations: x = 3t²+6t+4, y = t³. Find coordinates of any stationary points that are also inflection points.
questions.markingGuide: dx/dt=6t+6, dy/dt=3t². dy/dx=3t²/(6(t+1))=t²/(2(t+1)). For stationary: dy/dx=0 → t=0. At t=0: x=4, y=0. Check inflection: d²y/dx² changes sign at t=0. Point (4,0).

The radius of curvature is ρ = (1+(dy/dx)²)^(3/2)/|d²y/dx²|.

Find ρ for y = cos²(2x) at x = π/4.
questions.markingGuide: dy/dx = –2sin(2x)cos(2x) × 2 = –2sin(4x). Wait: dy/dx = 2cos(2x)·(–2sin(2x)) = –4sin(2x)cos(2x) = –2sin(4x). At π/4: dy/dx = –2sin(π) = 0. d²y/dx² = –8cos(4x). At π/4: d²y/dx² = –8cos(π) = 8. ρ = (1+0)^(3/2)/|8| = 1/8. Hmm: let me recheck. y=cos²(2x). dy/dx = 2cos(2x)(–2sin(2x)) = –2sin(4x). d²y/dx² = –8cos(4x). At x=π/4: dy/dx = –2sin(π)=0. d²y/dx² = –8cos(π) = 8. ρ = 1/8.

questions.text: Find stationary points of y = (ln x)/(2x), x > 0.
questions.markingGuide: dy/dx = (1/x·2x–ln x·2)/(4x²) = (2–2ln x)/(4x²) = (1–ln x)/(2x²). Set=0: ln x=1, x=e.

Parametric: x = 5/e^(t), y = 5e^(t). Find coordinates where dy/dx = –4.
The curve y² = 10x – x² is symmetrical about the x-axis. A rectangle ABCD is inscribed with B and C on the curve. Find the value of x for the left edge that maximises the area.
questions.markingGuide: y² = 10x–x² = –(x–5)²+25. y = √(25–(x–5)²). Let left edge at x=a, right edge at 10–a (by symmetry). Width = 10–2a. Height = 2√(10a–a²). A = 2(10–2a)√(10a–a²). Use substitution u=5–a: A = 4u√(25–u²). dA/du = 4√(25–u²)–4u²/√(25–u²) = 4(25–2u²)/√(25–u²). Set=0: u²=12.5, u=5/√2. a=5–5/√2≈1.46.
